description: This file contains the server-side logic for the SignUpPage in an online examination system. It handles user registration, including saving user details and an uploaded image to a database, and redirects to the login page upon success.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: The code-behind class for the SignUpPage ASP.NET Web Form, managing user registration logic.

methods.description: Handles the sign-up button click event, validating passwords, saving user data and image to the database, and redirecting.
